headline: Senator Bernie Sanders tells the heads of OpenAI, Anthropic and Meta to pause AI development or face Senate action.
score_reason: Pool 6 kept; letter read in full through the relaying article, no overstatement.
importance_line: The demand to pause frontier AI work affects the public and the firms named, and a pause law is unlikely to pass in the current Congress, so the pressure is mainly public.
summary: Axios reports, as relayed by International Business Times, that Senator Bernie Sanders, a Vermont independent in the US Senate, wrote to Sam Altman, chief executive of OpenAI, Dario Amodei, chief executive of Anthropic, and Mark Zuckerberg, chief executive of Meta, urging them to pause AI development. Sanders warned that if they do not act, he and his Senate colleagues will, though a law forcing a pause would be unlikely to gain enough support in the current Congress.
notes: Axios is named as the first reporter of the letter (per the relaying article); Axios itself not opened. The url is the IBTimes page we read. Event date not stated.
